decisions.statement: A task of `next_character` scope rolls once the effective character has progressed at the task.
Only the effective character's progress rolls a `next_character` task.
A task of `next_character` scope naming no effective character does not roll.
An `all_characters` task rolls once every character on the roster has completed or progressed.
A character the game has no record for counts as not progressed.
The roster is every character the account has rather than the characters lately played.
A task of another scope is not rolled by a character's own progress.
A roster holding nobody rolls nothing.
A mark naming another task answers for the other task alone.
A verdict has the reason the verdict was reached.

definition: whether a task comes round again, judged from what each character did at it
